notes.title: Athenian Rhapsody - Full Game Releasing May 14th!!!
notes.content:
[h2]Athenian Rhapsody is releasing on May 14th!!![/h2]

You can finally experience the ENTIRE world of Athens for yourself on [b]May 14th!![/b] Are you excited??? I might be!!! It's been real, it's been fun... Some might even say it's been real fun!

The full game of Athenian Rhapsody comes to you at full force - prepare for an all-new adventure full of characters to bond with, pathways to travel, stories to experience, and mysteries to unravel... All at your own pace. 

[b]My Rhapsody is almost complete - Now it's almost time to begin yours![/b]

You can redeem your Tokens from Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon in the full version of Athenian Rhapsody to receive special armors, items, and even a [i]friendly little visit from an old friend! A [b]BURGER[/b] friend!!! Are you excited?? For the burger??? Again?????[/i]

Remember, this is a different Steam Page - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1671720/Athenian_Rhapsody/]find the full game HERE!!![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40954853/363fd7b228055ab76fe28d81f31c4afac061d558.png[/img]

[b]Develop your own stories.

Share them with your friends.

Get allergies and irritable bowel syndrome while wearing floaties and being followed around by a huge, muscular squid with shades on.[/b]
